name: Kirin Holdings Company, Limited
note: Japanese beverage group listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its Singapore arm owned 51% of Myanmar Brewery and Mandalay Brewery, joint ventures with the Myanmar military conglomerate MEHL (UN Fact-Finding Mission on Myanmar, A/HRC/42/CRP.3, 2019), until Kirin announced in February 2022 that it would withdraw from Myanmar following the 2021 coup (Human Rights Watch, 2022-02-17).
